## External Contribution Boundary

External copyrighted contributions are closed for Nexora SAGE 1.0.0. Code,
tests, fixtures, evaluation data and substantial documentation cannot be
accepted or merged. Issues, reproducible bug reports, design discussion and
review feedback remain welcome.
